title_zh: 先补充采访再修改校报报道

scenario.label_zh: 修订校报报道的证据与评价
scenario.goal_zh: 区分记者评价与已核实事实，约定补充采访并把指责改为可回答的问题

context_zh: 英国一所学校的初级记者伊莫金与编辑哈立德核对一篇关于社团取消活动的报道。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: This is my first piece of journalism. Could you check the opening before I send it?

sentences.speaker: Khalid
sentences.text: Of course. Being a junior reporter doesn't mean you have to get everything right alone.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: I wrote that the club leader doesn't care about the members. She cancelled their trip.

sentences.speaker: Khalid
sentences.text: That's a judgement about her motives. Have you asked why she cancelled it?

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: No. I only spoke to two disappointed members. Should I make the whole article neutral?

sentences.speaker: Khalid
sentences.text: Keep their concerns, but be objective about what we know. The cancellation is a fact; her reasons aren't clear yet.

sentences.speaker: Imogen
sentences.text: I'll ask her what happened and change that accusation into a question about the decision.

sentences.speaker: Khalid
sentences.text: Good. Send me the revised opening after you've included her response, or said clearly that we're still waiting.
